We further show that their Kronecker factors are governed by divergence-weighted residuals rather than the raw approximation error, explaining how these spectral preferences are realized in the resulting preconditioners. Empirically, we observe that the top covariance eigenspace is substantially better aligned with the Hessian matrix, while the tail spectrum is much noisier and unreliable. Motivated by these findings, we propose a subspace-aware Kronecker optimizer that applies eigenvalue-based preconditioning in the top subspace and uses an adaptive isotropic acceleration constant in the bottom subspace.

</details>


### [248] [Semi-Supervised Noise Adaptation: Transferring Knowledge from Noise Domain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00558)
*Yuan Yao,Jin Song,Huixia Li,Tongtong Yuan,Jiaqi Wu,Yu Zhang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出半监督噪声适应（SSNA）问题，利用合成噪声域提升目标域泛化，并设计噪声适应框架（NAF）实现性能改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究发现噪声域（如高斯分布）可作为半监督学习中的替代源域，但缺乏系统性利用方法。

Method: 建立噪声域影响泛化的理论界，并基于此设计噪声适应框架（NAF）。

Result: 实验证明NAF能有效收紧目标域泛化界，显著提升性能。

Conclusion: 噪声域可作为半监督学习的有效知识源，NAF框架验证了其实际应用价值。

Abstract: Transfer learning aims to facilitate the learning of a target domain by transferring knowledge from a source domain. The source domain typically contains semantically meaningful samples (*e.g.*, images) to facilitate effective knowledge transfer. However, a recent study observes that the noise domain constructed from simple distributions (*e.g.*, Gaussian distributions) can serve as a surrogate source domain in the semi-supervised setting, where only a small proportion of target samples are labeled while most remain unlabeled. Based on this surprising observation, we formulate a novel problem termed *Semi-Supervised Noise Adaptation* (SSNA), which aims to leverage a synthetic noise domain to improve the generalization of the target domain. To address this problem, we first establish a generalization bound characterizing the effect of the noise domain on generalization, based on which we propose a Noise Adaptation Framework (NAF). Extensive experiments demonstrate that NAF effectively leverages the noise domain to tighten the generalization bound of the target domain, leading to improved performance. The codes are available at https://github.com/AIResearch-Group/SSNA.

</details>


### [249] [Diagnosing LLM Arbitration Behavior over Pre-evidence Epistemic States in RAG-based Fact-Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01120)
*Yuxi Sun,Wenbo Shang,Wei Gao,Xin Huang,Jing Ma*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文提出了PAVE测试平台，用于评估RAG事实核查场景中LLM验证器在检前知识（先验）与检索证据（上下文）冲突时的仲裁行为。实验表明，不同LLM的仲裁方式高度不可靠且依赖模型，并基于此提出了一种轻量级的JSD测试时仲裁方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测框架未考虑检索前的大模型自身知识（先验）与检索证据之间可能存在的冲突，也无法衡量验证器如何在两者之间进行仲裁。

Method: 构建PAVE诊断测试平台，将LLM验证器根据其先验正确性和置信度划分为四种认识状态，评估其在误导性证据和准确证据下的仲裁行为，并提出基于JSD的轻量级测试时仲裁方法。

Result: 在七种LLM上的实验表明，不同模型的先验-上下文仲裁行为高度不可靠且依赖模型具体属性。

Conclusion: 验证器选择对实际RAG事实核查至关重要，而所提出的JSD仲裁方法无需修改模型即可提升事实可靠性。

Abstract: In RAG-based fact-checking, LLMs are increasingly used as verifiers to check given claims against retrieved evidence. Their parametric knowledge can induce pre-evidence tendencies that may conflict with the retrieved context, yet existing evaluation frameworks do not characterize such prior-context discrepancy or measure how verifiers arbitrate between parametric and contextual signals. We introduce \textsc{PAVE} (\emph{Prior-Aware Verifier Evaluation}), a diagnostic testbed that stratifies an LLM verifier into four epistemic states based on the correctness and confidence of its pre-evidence prior and evaluates its arbitration behavior on this new benchmark, i.e., whether it persists in correct prior under misleading evidence, and whether it corrects wrong prior when accurate evidence is provided. Experiments across seven LLMs reveal unreliable and highly model-dependent prior-context arbitration, highlighting the importance of verifier selection for real-world RAG-based fact-checking applications. Based on these findings, we propose a lightweight JSD-based test-time arbitration method that improves factual reliability without modifying the underlying model, achieving competitive performance across diverse LLM families.

</details>


### [250] ["Skill issues'': data-centric optimization of lakehouse agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01185)
*Nicole Rose Schneider,Davide Ghilardi,Giacomo Piccinini,Jacopo Tagliabue*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 在分支数据湖屋环境中，通过数据为中心的优化流程生成任务-验证器对，并在隔离沙箱中执行候选技能，利用轨迹信号和湖屋状态的程序化检查进行评分，优化后的技能在25个任务上准确性提升31.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理的成功不仅依赖模型质量，还依赖教授代理如何使用系统的技能和环境文件，本文旨在优化这些工件以提高代理性能。

Method: 提出数据为中心的优化流程，生成任务-验证器对，在隔离沙箱中执行候选技能，并使用轨迹级信号和湖屋状态的程序化检查对轨迹进行评分。

Result: 初步评估中，优化后的技能在25个任务上准确性提升31.9%。

Conclusion: 写路径数据工作流为优化代理技能提供了有用基础，超越了只读任务。

Abstract: Coding agents are becoming users of data infrastructure, but their success depends not only on model quality: it also depends on the skills and environment files that teach agents how to use a system. We study how to optimize these artifacts for agents operating on a branching lakehouse, Bauplan. In our setting, headless APIs and Git-like data primitives expose data workflows through code, branches, commits, and merges. Our central observation is that a branching lakehouse turns data-agent evaluation from an output-matching problem into a state-verification problem: agent-generated pipeline code induces concrete, inspectable lakehouse changes. We present a data-centric optimization pipeline that generates task-verifier pairs, executes candidate skills in isolated sandboxes, and scores trajectories using both trace-level signals and programmatic checks over lakehouse state. In a preliminary evaluation on 25 tasks, optimized skills improve accuracy by 31.9%. These results suggest that write-path data workflows provide a useful substrate for optimizing agent skills beyond read-only tasks.

</details>


### [251] [SIRIUS-SQL: Anchoring Multi-Candidate Text-to-SQL in Execution Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01246)
*Leo Luo,Haining Xie,Siqi Shen,Zhipeng Ma,Rui Ling,Hang Xu,Hefeng Jiang,Dingwei Chen,Yang Li,Peng Chen,Jie Jiang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: SIRIUS-SQL通过难度平滑强化学习、执行生命周期分类修复和置信门控混合选择器，解决了多候选文本转SQL系统的三个耦合弱点，在BIRD dev和SPIDER测试集上分别达到75.88%和91.20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单通道文本转SQL系统在复杂模式上不可靠，而多候选方案存在三个耦合弱点：单生成器采样冗余、统一修复策略忽视错误类型差异、选择器视角单一导致漏判。

Method: 提出SIRIUS-SQL：1) 难度平滑强化学习训练SIRIUS-32B生成多样化可执行候选，用通用大模型补充专家遗漏；2) 执行生命周期分类将运行错误、超时、空结果分别导向针对性修复；3) 置信门控混合选择器结合执行结果一致性与成对SQL形式判断，仅在接近平局时启用确定性结构检查。

Result: 在BIRD dev达75.88%，SPIDER测试集达91.20%，两个通用配对方案在BIRD dev上超越当前最强多候选系统Agentar-Scale-SQL。

Conclusion: 通过解耦多候选生成、差异化修复和混合选择，SIRIUS-SQL显著提升了复杂多候选文本转SQL的可靠性和性能。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL on complex schemas is unreliable on a single pass, so recent systems generate multiple SQL candidates and let voting filter out errors. Yet voting alone is not enough, because the multi-candidate recipe has three coupled weaknesses: 1) sampling more from a single generator produces increasingly redundant candidates, 2) existing pipelines apply one generic correction to every non-clean execution result, while runtime errors, timeouts, and empty results each indicate a different distance from correctness, and 3) existing selectors rely on a single angle such as result-majority voting or pairwise SQL comparison, missing what other angles would have caught. We present SIRIUS-SQL, which addresses all three weaknesses. A difficulty-smoothing RL recipe trains SIRIUS-32B to generate diverse executable SQL candidates, paired with a generalist LLM that fills in gaps left by the specialist. An execution-grounded lifecycle classifies each outcome and applies targeted repair before candidates re-enter the pool. A confidence-gated hybrid selector combines execution-result agreement with pairwise SQL-form judgment, escalating only near-tied cases to a deterministic structural check. SIRIUS-SQL reaches 75.88% on BIRD dev and 91.20% on SPIDER test. Two of three generalist pairings surpass Agentar-Scale-SQL, the strongest published multi-candidate system on BIRD dev.

</details>


### [252] [Mapping the evolution of small reservoirs in Brazil from 1984 to 2025 using deep learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00675)
*Kylen Solvik,Luis Gustavo Carvalho,Marcia N. Macedo*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 利用深度学习模型绘制了巴西1984-2025年间小于1平方公里的小型水库年度地图，发现水库数量从263,913增至996,245，总面积从3,510增至8,550平方公里。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巴西广泛存在的小型农业水库未被充分研究，缺乏可靠检测方法和全国性数据集，导致其环境影响被忽视。

Method: 基于Landsat 5-9数据，训练深度学习计算机视觉模型，自动分割小型溪流供水水库，生成1984-2025年巴西全国年度水库地图。

Result: 小型水库数量增长近四倍，总面积翻倍，并首次公开了四十年间小型水库演变的国家级年度数据集。

Conclusion: 该数据集揭示了巴西小型溪流坝的广泛程度和累积影响，为淡水生态系统和水资源管理提供了关键见解。

Abstract: Water research in Brazil largely overlooks the widespread damming of small streams for agricultural uses such as watering cattle, farm-scale hydropower, irrigation, and aquaculture. These ubiquitous dams and their reservoirs can alter water temperature, stream connectivity, aquatic habitats, greenhouse gas emissions, and evaporative water losses. Mapping small reservoirs is challenging because it requires reliably detecting small water bodies and distinguishing artificial reservoirs from natural lakes. As a result, most regional and global datasets exclude them. To address this gap, we trained a deep learning computer vision model to accurately segment small ($< 1 km^2$), stream-fed, surface water reservoirs in Brazil leveraging data from Landsat 5-9. Applying our model from 1984 to 2025, we created annual reservoir maps for the entire country to evaluate how their count, size, and distribution have changed over time. The number of detected reservoirs grew nearly fourfold from 263,913 to 996,245, while their total surface area increased from 3510 $km^2$ to 8550 $km^2$. To our knowledge, this is the first country-wide annual dataset representing the evolution of small reservoirs over four decades. The publicly available annual maps highlight the extent and cumulative impacts of the small stream impoundments across Brazil, providing actionable insights for managing freshwater ecosystems and water resources.

</details>


### [253] [SkillSmith: Co-Evolving Skills and Tools for Self-Improving Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01314)
*Yangbo Wei,Zhen Huang,Shaoqiang Lu,Junhong Qian,Qifan Wang,Chen Wu,Lei He*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出SkillSmith框架，实现技能与工具的协同进化，通过生态效用模型和反模式记录提升多技能协同表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化智能体假设固定工具层且独立评估技能，无法修复工具级故障或推理技能间交互。

Method: 引入统一提案空间进行原子技能-工具联合修改，采用Lotka-Volterra生态动力模型估计技能交互矩阵，并记录反模式加速诊断。

Result: 在三个基准（含WildClawBench）及五个Qwen3.5模型规模上，SkillSmith持续优于强基线，任务复杂度和多技能共激活越高收益越明显。

Conclusion: 技能-工具协同进化和生态交互建模能有效提升自进化智能体的适应性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Recent self-evolving agents have shown that skills can be discovered, refined, and accumulated through execution. However, existing skill-evolution frameworks typically assume a fixed tool layer and evaluate each skill independently, limiting their ability to repair tool-level failures or reason about interactions among skills. We propose SkillSmith, a synergy-aware skill-tool co-evolution framework. SkillSmith introduces a unified proposal space in which reflection produces atomic bundles that jointly modify skills and tools, allowing tools to be wrapped, edited, composed, split, or retired when skill evolution identifies a reusable capability gap. To guide this joint search, SkillSmith maintains an ecological utility model inspired by Lotka-Volterra dynamics, where an interaction matrix estimated from execution traces captures pairwise complementarity and conflict among skills and provides pressure signals for retrieval, mutation prioritization, and retirement. Furthermore, SkillSmith records anti-patterns, including failure signatures, causal attributions, and remedies, to accelerate diagnosis and veto proposals that repeat known mistakes. Experiments on three benchmarks, including WildClawBench, and five Qwen3.5 model scales show that SkillSmith consistently outperforms strong baselines, with gains that amplify as task complexity and multi-skill co-activation increase.

</details>


### [254] [Transferring Information Across Interventions in Causal Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01457)
*Mohammad Ali Javidian*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出图耦合因果贝叶斯优化，通过共享因果参数将不同干预效果关联起来，在可识别线性高斯因果模型中实现信息增益对数增长与三源误差分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果贝叶斯优化孤立学习每种干预的效果，未利用因果系统中共享底层机制的特性，导致样本效率低下，尤其在目标父节点无法直接干预且干预数据稀疏的场景。

Method: 构建因果核函数，通过小规模共享因果参数的不确定性将不同干预效果耦合；理论推导线性高斯模型下核的低秩性（界于共享参数数量而非干预空间大小），并给出信息增益对数界与三源误差分解。

Result: 在理论对齐的线性高斯系统、共享机制压力测试及标准因果优化基准上，方法保持因果贝叶斯优化优势的同时实现跨干预信息迁移，最大增益出现在目标父节点不可直接干预、需在大量候选干预中复用稀疏数据时。

Conclusion: 图耦合机制有效提升了稀疏干预场景下的优化效率，且非线性与自适应扩展进一步拓展了适用性。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization is a popular way to optimize expensive systems, where every experiment, simulation, or intervention costs time or money. In its standard form, it treats the variables we control as plain inputs to a black box and cannot tell apart mere correlation from a real cause and effect. Causal Bayesian optimization closes part of this gap by using a known causal graph together with observational data to decide which variables are worth intervening on. Existing methods, however, learn the effect of each possible intervention almost in isolation, even though in a causal system these effects usually share the same underlying mechanisms. We propose graph-coupled causal Bayesian optimization, which ties the different intervention effects together through the uncertainty we have about a small set of shared causal parameters. The result is a causal kernel that lets evidence collected from one intervention improve our estimate of related interventions. For identifiable linear Gaussian causal models, we show that this kernel has low rank, bounded by the number of shared parameters rather than by the size of the intervention menu. This in turn yields an information-gain bound that grows only logarithmically in the optimization horizon, and a regret bound that cleanly separates three sources of error: optimization, causal estimation, and the choice of which intervention sets to consider. We also describe nonlinear and adaptive extensions. Across theory-aligned Gaussian systems, shared-mechanism stress tests, and standard causal optimization benchmarks, the method keeps the benefits of causal Bayesian optimization while transferring information across related interventions, with the clearest gains when direct interventions on the target's parents are unavailable and sparse interventional data must be reused across a large family of candidate interventions.

</details>


### [255] [Distributed GNEP Algorithms without Multiplier Sharing and Applications to Multi-Robot Coordination and Contextual Bandit-Based Active Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00759)
*Shao-An Yin*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出了无需拉格朗日乘子交换的完全分布式连续时间算法，用于解决广义纳什均衡问题，并扩展到主动学习中的自适应策略选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布式算法需要代理交换拉格朗日乘子以强制共识，导致信息交换量大且隐私保护不足；主动学习中手动设计的策略仅适用于特定数据集。

Method: 针对强单调博弈设计无乘子交换的连续时间分布式算法，并提出离散化方案；在主动学习中使用上下文赌博机自适应选择策略。

Result: 算法收敛到一般广义纳什均衡（不限于变分均衡），初始化影响均衡点；主动学习方法在公开数据集上有效。

Conclusion: 提出的方法减少了信息交换，提升了隐私保护，且能处理更广义的均衡问题；主动学习框架适应未知数据集类型。

Abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence have expanded the focus from classical optimization to include equilibrium analysis in noncooperative games. Many such games involve shared constraints, leading to Generalized Nash Equilibrium Problems (GNEPs). Existing distributed algorithms typically require agents to exchange Lagrange multipliers to enforce consensus and compute variational-GNEs (v-GNEs).
  This work introduces fully distributed continuous-time algorithms and establishes convergence without requiring multiplier exchange, thereby reducing information exchange per iteration while improving privacy preservation. The analysis focuses on strongly monotone games with convex individual constraints and linear shared constraints. I also propose several discretization schemes for the continuous-time algorithms. The proposed approach converges to general GNEs, rather than being restricted to v-GNEs, with the attained equilibrium depending on the initialization. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated through applications in multi-robot coordination and placement.
  In the second part, this work includes research conducted in collaboration with Amazon scientists. One of the most challenging problems in real-world machine learning is labeled data collection, which typically requires substantial human effort and cost. Active learning aims to reduce this labeling requirement. Existing handcrafted active learning strategies, however, generally perform well only on specific types of datasets, which are often unknown in advance. In this work, I propose using contextual bandits to adaptively select the most suitable active learning strategy. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated on publicly available external datasets.

</details>


### [256] [Partial Fairness Awareness: Belief-Guided Strategic Mechanism for Strategic Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00826)
*Xinpeng Lv,Chunyuan Zheng,Yunxin Mao,Renzhe Xu,Hao Zou,Shanzhi Gu,Liyang Xu,Huan Chen,Yuanlong Chen,Wenjing Yang,Haotian Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出部分公平感知（PFA）策略，通过公开候选公平约束集合并隐藏真实约束，结合信念引导的迭代机制，缓解策略分类中公平性暴露引发的操纵与福利损失困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平感知方法在公平性暴露中面临两难：公开约束导致策略性操纵和公平性逆转，隐藏约束则降低社会福利并抑制真实改进。

Method: 提出部分公平感知问题，释放候选公平约束集合并隐藏真实约束；引入信念引导机制，智能体通过迭代交互和反馈更新对候选约束的信念分布，逐步对齐系统真实约束。

Result: 在真实和合成数据集上，相比完全公开或私有公平制度，PFA实现更低的群体公平差距、更高的合格个体接受率及更稳定的结果。

Conclusion: 部分公开公平约束结合信念引导能有效调和策略分类中公平性与实用性的矛盾。

Abstract: Strategic machine learning investigates scenarios where agents manipulate their features to receive favorable decisions from predictive models. To address fairness concerns intrinsic to strategic classification, recent work has introduced group-specific fairness constraints. However, current fairness-aware approaches face a fundamental dilemma in the issue of fairness exposure: making these constraints public enables strategic manipulation and can lead to fairness reversal, while keeping them hidden may reduce social welfare and discourage genuine improvement. To fill this gap, we subsequently propose the problem of partial fairness awareness (PFA), as our theoretical analysis informs that such a dilemma can be mitigated by releasing the candidate set of fairness constraints and concealing the grounding constraint. To be specific, we introduce a belief-guided strategic mechanism, wherein agents iteratively interact with the decision system and maintain a belief distribution over the candidate set of fairness constraints. This belief-guided process enables agents, through iterative interaction and feedback, to update their belief distribution over the candidate set, thereby gradually aligning their belief with the grounding fairness constraint employed by the system. Extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that PFA achieves lower group fairness gaps, higher acceptance of truly qualified individuals, and more stable outcomes compared to fully public or private fairness regimes.

</details>


### [257] [Beyond Independent Manipulation: Individual Fairness-aware Strategic Classification with Peer Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00827)
*Xinpeng Lv,Chunyuan Zheng,Yunxin Mao,Renzhe Xu,Jinxuan Yang,Yuanlong Chen,Wangrong Huang,Shaowu Yang,Wenjing Yang,Xinwang Liu,Peng Cui,Haotian Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出了个体公平感知的战略分类（IFSC）框架，通过建模同侪驱动操纵并引入鲁棒学习，缓解了传统方法忽视个体公平中代理相互依赖的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平感知战略分类主要关注群体公平且假设代理独立响应，但个体公平要求相似个体获得相似结果，导致代理操纵相互依赖，传统独立模型无法准确刻画这种战略操纵。

Method: IFSC框架通过模拟基于相似性模仿（向可见的已接受同侪学习）来建模个体公平驱动的同侪操纵，并学习后操纵分布下的分类器；同时引入随机扰动以应对同侪可见性不确定性。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，IFSC提升了个体公平一致性并缓解了模仿诱导的分布扭曲。

Conclusion: IFSC有效解决了个体公平下代理操纵相互依赖问题，增强了分类器的鲁棒性和公平性。

Abstract: Strategic classification (SC) investigates scenarios where agents manipulate their features to obtain favorable decisions from predictive models. Existing fairness-aware SC approaches primarily focus on group fairness and typically assume that agents respond independently. However, when individual fairness is required, ensuring similar individuals receive similar outcomes, agents' manipulation becomes interdependent: an agent's preferred manipulation depends on the neighborhoods' outcomes. This induces a mismatch between classical SC formulations and fairness-aware decision settings, where independent models no longer accurately characterize strategic manipulations. To address this issue, we introduce individual fairness-aware strategic classification (IFSC), a framework that models peer-driven manipulation arising from individual fairness, where agents imitate nearby positively decided peers to obtain favorable outcomes. IFSC characterizes strategic manipulation as similarity-based imitation toward visible accepted peers and learns classifiers under the resulting post-manipulation distributions. To account for uncertainty in peer observability, IFSC employs a robust learning process that introduces stochastic perturbations during manipulation simulation. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that IFSC improves individual-fairness consistency and mitigates imitation-induced distortions.

</details>


### [258] [Online Packet Scheduling with Deadlines and Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00835)
*Gianmarco Genalti,Achraf Azize,Vianney Perchet*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Network routers that enforce Quality-of-Service (QoS) guarantees must decide, at every clock cycle, which expiring packet of information to transmit, even when the value of the packet is unknown until it is processed. We frame this problem as the Online Packet Scheduling with Deadlines (OPSD) problem under Partial Feedback: packets arrive at every clock cycle, with different deadlines, but the weights are only observed after execution. Under a stochastic assumption on the unknown weights, we explore different variants of the OPSD problem with bandit feedback. We establish a connection between our setting and the sleeping bandits problem, and set our learning goal to $α$-regret minimization. We provide algorithms with provable $α$-regret guarantees under different spans of slackness, distinguishing systems allowing for randomization and systems that do not. In every scenario, our algorithms achieve an $α$-regret upper bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\sqrt{KT}\right)$, matching the lower bound for the standard bandit setting. In the practically relevant case of $2$-bounded deadline instances, where the deadline is set at most one clock cycle away from the arrival, our deterministic algorithm achieves the provably tightest possible competitive ratio. Remarkably, when the number of distinct packet types $K\ge 2$ is finite, it is possible to break the well-established $Φ= \frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$ competitive ratio barrier and attain a tighter competitive ratio $θ_K$ ranging in $[\sqrt{2}, Φ)$.

</details>


### [259] [Structure-Guided Adaptive Propagation for Protein-Protein Interaction Site Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01781)
*Enqiang Zhu,Yizi Liu,Yilong Luo,Yao Chen,Yu Zhang,Baoshan Ma*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出了一种结构引导的自适应传播模型SGAP-PPIS用于蛋白质相互作用位点预测，通过等变图神经网络生成残基级别传播系数，根据局部几何环境自适应平衡特征保留与邻域扩散。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图的模型使用固定传播机制，无法适应蛋白质界面结构和功能异质性，难以区分真实相互作用位点和结构相似的非相互作用邻域。

Method: 利用等变图神经网络提取多尺度几何状态，生成残基级别的自适应传播系数，实现局部特征保留与邻域扩散的动态平衡。

Result: 在Test_60数据集上达到与最优方法竞争的性能，消融实验证实几何条件自适应传播、尺度对齐几何引导和多步传播状态表示共同提升了效果。

Conclusion: 自适应传播机制能够有效利用蛋白质界面几何异质性，为PPIS预测提供更精确的信息扩散方式。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interaction sites (PPIS) is essential for understanding cellular processes, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic target discovery. Graph-based deep learning has advanced PPIS prediction by incorporating residue-level structural context. However, most graph-based models still rely on fixed propagation schemes that treat all residues similarly, despite the structural and functional heterogeneity of protein interfaces. Such propagation may limit the ability to adapt information diffusion to local geometric environments, making it difficult to distinguish true interaction sites from structurally similar non-interacting neighbors. We present SGAP-PPIS, a structure-guided adaptive propagation model for PPIS prediction. Rather than using a fixed propagation mechanism, SGAP-PPIS leverages multi-scale geometric states from an equivariant graph neural network to generate residue-wise propagation coefficients. This design allows each residue to adaptively balance local feature preservation and neighborhood diffusion according to its geometric microenvironment. Experimental results show that SGAP-PPIS achieves competitive performance among the state-of-the-art methods on Test\_60. Ablation studies show that geometry-conditioned adaptive propagation, scale-aligned geometric guidance, and multi-step propagation-state representation jointly drive these improvements.

</details>


### [260] [Stochastic convergence of parallel asynchronous adaptive first-order methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01787)
*Serge Gratton,Philippe L. Toint*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出了一类异步自适应一阶优化方法，包含动量与不精确归一化变体，在非凸随机设置下证明O(1/√t)收敛性，数值实验显示其适用于异构大规模机器学习系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应优化方法多为同步实现，难以适应异构大规模机器学习系统中异步、非凸和随机训练的需求。

Method: 构建异步自适应优化方法类，涵盖多种流行算法的异步变体，并引入动量与不精确归一化机制；在完全随机非凸环境下分析收敛性。

Result: 在合理假设下，方法收敛阶为O(1/√t)（忽略对数因子），数值实验验证了在异构系统中的有效性。

Conclusion: 异步自适应优化方法在异构大规模机器学习中具有实用性和竞争力。

Abstract: A new class of asynchronous adaptive first-order optimization methods is introduced, comprising asynchronous variants of several popular algorithms. Versions of these methods using momentum and/or inexact normalization are also considered. The convergence of methods in the class on non-convex functions is analyzed in a fully stochastic setting, and is shown to be (up to logarithmic factors) of order O(1/sqrt{t}) under reasonable assumptions. Numerical experiments suggest that such asynchronous adaptive algorithms are very relevant in heterogeneous large-scale machine learning systems.

</details>


### [261] [Consistency evaluation of benchmarks used for causal discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01789)
*Yuzhe Zhang,Chihui Chen,Lina Yao,Chen Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 首次系统评估基准因果图质量，设计自动流水线通过检索论文并用大语言模型验证一致性，发现11个流行基准与领域研究契合度差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法评估因基准图与领域知识错位而困难，尤其影响基于大语言模型的方法。

Method: 构建自动化流水线，从科学数据库检索相关论文，并利用大语言模型检查基准因果图与论文的一致性。

Result: 对11个真实世界基准处理38,081篇论文，显示不同基准与领域研究的契合度差异巨大。

Conclusion: 基准因果图质量对因果发现研究有重要影响，需谨慎选择与使用。

Abstract: In graphical causal model, causal discovery aims to construct a causal graph based on numerical data and domain knowledge in plain text. However, the evaluation of causal discovery methods remains a challenge in the area as the progress of domain researches often makes benchmark causal graphs contain mis-aligned knowledge. This problem especially affects the evaluation of large language model (LLM) based causal discovery methods as they are sensitive to the new discoveries in the literature. This work is the first to systematically study the quality of benchmark causal graphs. Specifically, we design a pipeline that automatically retrieves relevant research papers from scientific databases, and prompts LLMs to check the consistency between the benchmark causal graphs and domain research papers. We evaluate 11 popular real-world benchmarks, for which our pipeline in total proceeds 38,081 domain papers. Our results show that popular benchmarks vary significantly in their consistency with domain research, with clear implications for causal discovery research.

</details>


### [262] [Task Structure Reverses Layerwise State Encoding in Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00926)
*Yuhang Jiang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 序列模型的读取机制并非仅由架构决定，而是架构与任务共同作用的结果：例如，Parity任务下状态在Mamba和RNN的深层集中，在Transformer中逐步构建；而Dyck-k任务则完全反转。我们通过非交换的S₃排列组合任务分离了代数结构与计算结构的影响，发现分组依据是计算结构而非交换性。因果干预表明，线性可读状态不一定对应计算瓶颈，例如在预训练规模下，Mamba最后层可读性强但非瓶颈，而Pythia的Dyck任务存在中层瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献常将序列模型的状态编码视为架构特征（如RNN集中可读状态，注意力模型分散），但忽略了任务对读取轮廓的影响。作者旨在探究架构与任务如何共同决定机制的签名，并区分代数结构（交换性）与计算结构（前缀更新 vs. 栈）的影响。

Method: 在Transformer、Mamba、Mamba-2、LSTM、GRU五种架构上，针对Parity、bounded-depth Dyck-k、非交换S₃排列组合三个任务进行逐层探针分析（linear probing），结合Mamba的Conv1D归因和因果干预（如层消融、激活修补）。

Result: 同一架构在不同任务下读取轮廓反转：Parity为Mamba/RNN深层集中、Transformer逐步构建；Dyck-k完全相反。S₃任务与Parity分组一致（而非Dyck），表明分组基于计算结构。因果干预显示，在小型模型上线性可读路径常是功能必需的；在预训练规模上，Pythia Dyck有强中层瓶颈（L6-L7消融使160M模型准确率下降约81%，410M模型L4-L18 plateau），而Mamba最后层可读但非瓶颈（中间层激活修补恢复97-98% logit差距）。

Conclusion: 机械性签名是架构与任务的共同属性。探针定位的是状态线性可用的位置，而非计算瓶颈的位置。需要结合探针与因果干预才能正确识别关键计算节点。

Abstract: Mechanistic studies of sequence models often treat layerwise state encodings as architectural traits: recurrent models concentrate readable state, attention-based models distribute it. We find that the same architecture reverses this profile when the task changes. Across Transformers, Mamba, Mamba-2, LSTMs, and GRUs, Parity is concentrated late in Mamba and the recurrent baselines and built gradually by Transformer; on bounded-depth Dyck-k the pattern flips. The same flip appears in fine-tuned Mamba-130M and Pythia-160M, and the Pythia Dyck bottleneck persists at 410M. Two explanations are conflated in the literature: algebraic structure (commutativity) versus computational structure (prefix update vs. stack). To separate them we add a third task: non-commutative S_3 permutation composition. S_3 groups with Parity, not Dyck, on layerwise probing across all five architectures and on Mamba-specific Conv1D attribution, so the grouping tracks computational structure rather than commutativity.
  Causal interventions show that, in the 4-layer formal models, linearly readable directions are often functionally necessary and can remain important at out-of-distribution lengths on Parity and Dyck. At pretrained scale the picture splits. Fine-tuned Pythia Dyck has a strong middle-layer bottleneck (L6-L7 ablation drops accuracy by roughly 81% at 160M; broader L4-L18 plateau at 410M), far weaker at the best-probe layer. Pretrained Mamba shows the complementary failure mode: its final layer is highly readable, no single probe direction breaks the task on Parity, Dyck, or S_3, yet mid-position activation patching there recovers about 97-98% of the clean-corrupted logit gap. Probing localizes where state is linearly available, not always where the computation is bottlenecked. Mechanistic signatures are properties of architecture and task together.

</details>


### [263] [WorldCoder-Bench: Benchmarking Physically Grounded 3D World Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01869)
*Shuo Lu,Yinuo Xu,Kecheng Yu,Siru Jiang,Yongcan Yu,Yubin Wang,Haitao Yang,Yuxiang Zhang,Bin Wang,Ran He,Jian Liang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出WorldCoder-Bench基准和StateProbe评估协议，用于测试大语言模型生成Three.js交互式3D世界的能力，发现当前模型在状态一致性和交互链完整性上表现不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准仅通过像素或DOM节点评估网页生成，无法捕捉Three.js世界在<canvas>内的物理约束、状态同步和交互逻辑。

Method: 构建包含2026个任务的基准（覆盖模拟、渲染、应用场景），并设计StateProbe协议，通过沙箱浏览器动态探测运行时状态和契约，结合Return on Automation和Time Efficiency Multiplier衡量正确性、成本和时间效益。

Result: 最优模型在WorldCoder-Core和WorldCoder-Robust上仅达27.8%和19.9%验证覆盖率，失败主因是状态模式漂移和交互链断裂，而非场景元素缺失；低成本/快速模型在简单领域仍具价值。

Conclusion: 当前模型生成可靠3D交互世界能力有限，需改进状态管理和长链交互的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly asked not only to write static interfaces, but to construct executable interactive worlds from natural language. Browser-native 3D, commonly built with Three.js, is a natural next frontier: generated programs must integrate assets, obey spatial and physical constraints, and keep user-facing controls synchronized with hidden runtime state. Existing web-generation benchmarks and evaluators, however, largely observe only pixels or DOM nodes, while the mechanics of a Three.js world unfold inside an opaque <canvas>. We introduce WorldCoder-Bench, a benchmark for autonomous, physically grounded 3D world synthesis. WorldCoder-Bench contains 2,026 expert-curated tasks across Simulation, Rendering, and Application scenarios, with optional .glb assets and hidden behavioral contracts. We further propose StateProbe, an execution-based protocol that probes generated programs in a sandboxed browser and verifies hidden, mutation-hardened contracts over runtime states and transitions. Beyond verification coverage, we report Return on Automation and Time Efficiency Multiplier to measure correctness-adjusted cost and time savings. Across nine frontier models, the best system reaches only 27.8% verification coverage on WorldCoder-Core and 19.9% on WorldCoder-Robust, with failures dominated by state-schema drift and broken interaction chains rather than missing scene elements. Utility metrics further show that cheap or fast models can still provide substantial value on easier domains. WorldCoder-Bench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WorldCoder-Bench/.

</details>


### [264] [When Parallelism Pays Off: Cohesion-Aware Task Partitioning for Multi-Agent Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00953)
*Xu Yang,Lunyiu Nie,Ethan Chandra,Stanislav Gannutin,Fangru Lin,Swarat Chaudhuri*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出Co-Coder，通过图划分和社区检测优化多智能体协作，在代码任务中同时提升效率、降低开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统中智能体间通信开销可能抵消并行收益，需理论化划分通信与计算代价。

Method: 将多智能体编排形式化为图划分问题，基于静态分析构建依赖图，用社区检测划分结构枢纽文件，并采用依赖感知调度器执行。

Result: 在28个真实任务上，相比序列和并行基线及Claude Code，Pass率提升14.0%，速度提升2.10倍，API成本降低35%，高依赖项目收益最大。

Conclusion: 内聚感知编排使并行代码智能体既理论可行又实际高效，为多智能体系统提供通用设计原则。

Abstract: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems offer a way to decompose complex tasks, such as coding, through parallelization and context isolation. However, adding agents in practice introduces inter-agent communication overhead, which incurs extra cost and can sometimes offset the efficiency gains. We formalize multi-agent orchestration as a graph partitioning problem that captures the communication-to-computation trade-off: task decomposition can shorten critical-path computation, but cross-agent dependencies require costly context transfer. We instantiate this view in repository-level software engineering and present Cohesion-aware Coder (Co-Coder), which builds dependency graphs from static analysis, isolates structural hub files, partitions the graph via community detection, and executes the partition with a dependency-aware scheduler.
  Across 28 real-world tasks on DevEval and CodeProjectEval, Co-Coder advances the Pareto-frontier over sequential and file-based parallel baselines as well as Claude Code with Agent Teams, lifting pass rate by up to 14.0%, achieving up to a 2.10x wall-clock speedup, and reducing API cost by up to 35%, with the largest gains on the most dependency-dense projects. Co-coder demonstrates how cohesion-aware orchestration can make parallel coding agents both theoretically grounded and practically efficient, suggesting a broader design principle for multi-agent systems.

</details>


### [265] [Optimal-Point Variance Reduction For Bayesian Optimization With Regret Guarantee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00956)
*Shion Takeno*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为最优点方差减少（OVR）的一步前瞻贝叶斯优化方法，仅需后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似，并证明其正则化版本可实现贝叶斯期望简单遗憾的上界趋零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一步前瞻BO方法（如熵搜索）虽经验有效，但依赖计算上不可行的近似且遗憾保证不足。

Method: 提出OVR方法，通过后验采样和蒙特卡洛近似实现一步前瞻，并引入正则化促进探索以得到理论保证。

Result: 得到了蒙特卡洛估计在输入域上的均匀误差界，并证明正则化OVR的贝叶斯期望简单遗憾上界趋于零。

Conclusion: OVR在理论保证和计算可行性之间取得平衡，数值实验验证了其有效性。

Abstract: This paper studies a one-step lookahead Bayesian optimization (BO) method and its theoretical guarantee. Although the empirical effectiveness of one-step lookahead BO methods, such as entropy search, has been studied extensively, they often rely on computationally intractable approximations, and their regret guarantees remain underdeveloped. Thus, this paper proposes a one-step lookahead BO method called optimal-point variance reduction (OVR), which requires only posterior sampling and Monte Carlo approximations. We obtain a uniform error bound over an input domain for the Monte Carlo estimation in OVR. Furthermore, we show that the regularized OVR, with the slight modification to promote exploration, achieves a vanishing Bayesian expected simple regret upper bound. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of OVR through numerical experiments.

</details>


### [266] [Data Enrichment for Symbolic Regression Using Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00988)
*Simon De Reuver,Tamas Kristof Toth,Teddy Lazebnik*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出物理引导的潜在扩散框架，通过生成物理一致的合成数据增强稀疏观测，提升符号回归在稀疏、噪声数据下发现控制方程的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号回归在稀疏、噪声或物理不完整观测下可靠性严重下降，现有数据增强方法需领域专业知识且可能误导方程发现。

Method: 结合变分自编码器、条件潜在扩散模型和物理信息残差校正器，生成受控制方程约束的合成场以补全稀疏观测。

Result: 在热传导、不可压缩Navier-Stokes流和牛顿引力势场景中，物理校正增强持续提升稀疏数据下的方程恢复效果，且不依赖额外领域知识。

Conclusion: 生成式物理增强可无需领域专业知识即强化符号回归的方程发现能力。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) offers a route to scientific discovery by converting observations into interpretable governing equations. However, despite its promise, its reliability degrades sharply when spatiotemporal measurements are sparse, noisy, or physically incomplete, as commonly occurring in practice. Data enrichment (DE) has been shown to be able to mitigate this limitation, yet additional samples can mislead equation discovery unless they preserve the physical structure of the target system. Such implication of DE requires narrow domain expertise as well as technical fluidity, highly limiting its practical usefulness. In this study, we introduce a physics-guided latent diffusion framework for DE for down the line SR models. The proposed framework combines a variational autoencoder, a conditional latent diffusion model, and a physics-informed residual corrector to complete sparse observations with synthetic fields constrained by governing relations. We evaluate the approach on heat conduction, incompressible Navier-Stokes flow, and a moving single-mass Newtonian gravitational potential, using GPLearn, DEAP, and PySR as downstream SR backends. Our results reveal that physics-corrected enrichment consistently improves recovery in sparse regimes across physical dynamics and SR models. These results show that generative enrichment can strengthen equation discovery without additional domain expertise.

</details>


### [267] [Algorithmic algorithm development with LLMs: A Case Study on LLM-Usage for Contraction Order Optimization in Tensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01975)
*Fabian Hoppe,Melven Röhrig-Zöllner,Philipp Knechtges*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 通过张量网络缩并顺序优化的案例，研究了基于LLM的算法开发，关注模型选择、评估指标和测试实例等设计因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索LLM在算法开发中的潜力，特别是验证器引导的进化编码代理的效能，同时强调人类科学家在评估、验证和解释中的重要性。

Method: 以OpenEvolve为案例，对比不同LLM和设计选择（如评估指标、测试实例），采用验证器引导的进化编码方法进行张量网络缩并顺序优化。

Result: 验证器引导的进化编码代理在算法开发中展现出潜力，但评估、验证和解释仍面临挑战，需人类科学家参与。

Conclusion: LLM辅助的进化编码方法对算法开发有前景，但人类监督下的严格评估和解释是必要的。

Abstract: We consider LLM-based algorithm development through a case study on contractionorder optimisation for tensor networks with OpenEvolve. We pay particular attention to the choice of the LLM as well as design choices such as evaluation metric and test instances. Our results highlight both the promise of verifier-guided evolutionary coding agents for algorithm development/improvement and the continuing importance of evaluation, validation, and interpretation -- and corresponding challenges -- by the human scientist.

</details>


### [268] [Topological texture analysis of microscopy images of dynamic casein gelation and its relation to rheological properties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02048)
*Zahra Tabatabaei,Diana Soto Aguilar,Jose C. Bonilla,Mathias P. Clausen,Jon Sporring*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出了一种结合拓扑数据分析、差分盒计数、多重分形分解和局部二值模式的工具箱，应用于STED显微图像，用于定量表征钠酪蛋白凝胶化过程中的微观结构演变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法如流变学仅能获得宏观平均响应，缺乏对凝胶化过程中微观结构转变的敏感性，需要一种能够解析复杂动态微观结构的定量工具。

Method: 集成TDA（追踪拓扑环与max-Betti-1曲线）、DBC、MFP和LBP，先在人造分形图像上验证，再应用于不同温度和GDL浓度下的STED时间序列图像。

Result: TDA揭示了滞后相、网络渗流引起的Betti-1急剧下降（对应溶胶-凝胶转变）以及凝胶后重组导致的上升；DBC和MFP证实了结构复杂性和空间异质性的变化；该方法能检测流变学无法捕捉的细微结构转变。

Conclusion: 该综合工具箱为食品与材料科学中具有动态微观结构演变的复杂体系提供了稳健的定量表征手段。

Abstract: We propose a novel computational toolbox that integrates Topological Data Analysis (TDA), Differential Box Counting (DBC), Multifractal Partition (MFP), and Local Binary Patterns (LBP), applied to time-lapse super-resolution STED microscopy images of sodium caseinate gelation induced by glucono-delta-lactone (GDL) at 30 °C and 40 °C and two GDL concentrations (1.8% and 3.5% w/v).
  TDA tracked topological loops, closed ring-like structures reflecting protein network interconnectivity, via max-Betti-1 curves, which revealed a lag phase of dispersed aggregates, a sharp decay coinciding with network percolation and the rheologically observed sol-gel transition, and a post-gelation increase corresponding to network rearrangements. These topological transitions were corroborated by DBC and MFP as these methods were able to resolve changes in structural complexity and spatial heterogeneity. The toolbox was validated on simulated fractal images prior to experimental application. Together, these descriptors provided sensitivity to subtle microstructural transitions that bulk rheology captured as averaged bulk mechanical responses. This integrated approach provides a robust quantitative tool for characterizing complex microstructure in food and material science with evolving microstructural dynamics. Code is available at https://github.com/Zahratabatabaei/Delifood_CV_paper.git

</details>


### [269] [Decision-Focused On-Policy Learning for Contextual Linear Optimization with Partial Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01081)
*Wyame Benslimane,Tinghan Ye,Pascal Van Hentenryck,Paul Grigas*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对部分反馈下序列性上下文线性优化的在线策略学习方法，通过混合梯度估计器结合无偏但高方差的得分函数估计与利用下游优化结构的决策聚焦组件，实现了O(T^{-1/2})的梯度范数上界，并在多个基准任务上优于上下文赌博机基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有决策聚焦学习方法大多假设离线数据且完全观测成本向量，但实际应用中常面临顺序决策和部分反馈（如赌博机设置）的挑战，亟需开发有效的在线策略学习方法。

Method: 学习一个随机预测-然后-优化策略，从条件分布中采样成本向量预测并求解下游线性优化问题；使用混合梯度估计器更新分布模型，包含得分函数估计器（无偏但高方差）和决策聚焦插件组件（利用辅助估计利用优化结构）。

Result: 证明了平均策略梯度范数的O(T^{-1/2})上界，与标准非凸SGD速率一致；在top-k选择、最短路径、组合定价和真实能源调度基准上，混合梯度方法在所有任务中均实现了比上下文赌博机基线更低的累积遗憾。

Conclusion: 混合梯度方法能有效结合策略梯度与决策聚焦结构的优势，在部分反馈下实现稳健的在线学习，适用于更广泛的序列决策场景。

Abstract: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictive models by optimizing downstream decision quality rather than standalone prediction accuracy. For contextual linear optimization, most existing DFL methods assume offline data and full observations of the objective cost vector. We develop an on-policy learning method for sequential contextual linear optimization under partial feedback, generalizing the standard bandit feedback setting. Our method learns a stochastic predict-then-optimize policy that samples a cost-vector prediction from a conditional distribution and solves the resulting downstream linear optimization problem. To update this distributional model, we introduce a two-component hybrid gradient estimator. The first component is a score function estimator, which provides an unbiased but potentially high-variance policy gradient estimate. The second is a decision-focused plug-in component that uses an auxiliary nuisance estimate of the latent cost vector to exploit the downstream optimization structure, becoming more informative as the estimate improves. We prove an $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ bound on the average squared policy-gradient norm, matching the standard non-convex SGD rate. Experiments on top-$k$ selection, shortest path, combinatorial pricing, and a real-data energy-scheduling benchmark show that the hybrid gradient approach achieves lower cumulative regret than contextual-bandit-style baselines across all benchmarks, using both Gaussian and richer conditional generative models. Code is available at https://github.com/Joeyetinghan/on-policy-bandit-dfl.

</details>


### [270] [An Abstract Worlds Semantic Framework for Belief Change Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02163)
*Daniel Grimaldi,M. Vanina Martinez,Ricardo O. Rodriguez*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需逻辑语法的集合论信念变更框架——抽象世界语义学（AWS），在该框架中世界被视为原语，通过世界收缩和世界修正算子统一分析经典与非优先信念变更模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信念变更理论（如AGM、KM）依赖逻辑语法，缺乏统一的语义基础，而Grove的成果虽涉及语义但未完全摆脱语法假设。本文旨在建立一种无语法假设的纯语义框架，以简化并泛化信念变更理论。

Method: 将世界视为原语元素，定义世界收缩与世界修正算子，并构造灵活算子以统一经典和非优先的信念变更构造。在经典命题逻辑下，该框架同质化地描述了AGM、KM及多重变更模型。

Result: AWS实现了对不同信念变更模型（AGM、KM、多重变更）的统一语义刻画，无需语法支持，成功简化并泛化了信念集合上的变更理论。

Conclusion: AWS为信念变更理论提供了一个系统化、泛化的语义基础，消除了对逻辑语法的依赖，促进了不同模型间的统一分析。

Abstract: This article proposes a set-theoretic framework for belief change, called Abstract Worlds Semantics, in which no logical syntax is assumed. Inspired by Grove's (1988) results, our approach treats worlds as primitive elements, over which world contraction and world revision operators are defined. This semantic framework enables a unified analysis of belief change models. Within this framework, we unify classical and non-prioritized belief change constructions by defining versatile operators. When classical propositional logic is considered, our framework provides a homogeneous account of AGM, KM, and Multiple Change models. In summary, AWS systematizes belief change frameworks and operators, simplifying and generalizing belief change theory over belief sets.

</details>


### [271] [CEON: Circular Economy Ontology Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02253)
*Huanyu Li,Els de Vleeschauwer,Robin Keskisärkkä,Mikael Lindecrantz,Mina Abd Nikooie Pour,Ying Li,Ben De Meester,Patrick Lambrix,Eva Blomqvist*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 为提升资源循环性，本文提出了循环经济本体网络（CEON），通过跨行业语义互操作实现产品生命周期数据共享，并在建筑、电子和纺织领域验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环经济需要跨行业信息共享和语义互操作，但现有知识表示难以涵盖多行业概念，CEON旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在Onto-DESIDE项目中开发CEON本体网络，定义跨行业核心概念，支持语义感知数据文档。

Result: 通过建筑、电子和纺织行业的跨部门数据文档场景验证了CEON的有效性。

Conclusion: CEON可支撑循环经济中跨行业语义互操作，促进资源循环策略实施。

Abstract: Increasing the circularity of resource use in our society has been recognized as a path to sustainability, i.e., transitioning into a more circular economy. There are many different circular strategies to do so, such as reusing products and components, refurbishing and remanufacturing used products, or recycling left-over or used materials. To enable these strategies, it is necessary to share information at the infrastructure level and to communicate between industry sectors along the product life cycle. Enabling semantic interoperability in this information sharing and communication is therefore a key to increasing circularity. However, knowledge representation for the circular economy (CE) domain, which involves many relevant industry sectors related to product life cycles, remains challenging. To bridge this gap, we developed the Circular Economy Ontology Network (CEON) within the Onto-DESIDE project. This ontology network aims to fill gaps in CE by defining cross-sectorial concepts and to enable semantics-aware data documentation. We demonstrate CEON through cross-industry data documentation scenarios spanning construction, electronics, and textile sectors.

</details>


### [272] [Repair Before Veto: Repair-Augmented Constraint Learning for Contextual Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02326)
*Yifan Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出修复增强约束学习（RACL）框架，将已知修复算子融入分类器语义，实现“先修复再否决”的决策逻辑，显著降低假否决率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统硬约束作为终局否决，忽略了系统已知有限修复选项（如添加票务、修改配置）的常见场景，现有方法未学习是否应在否决前进行修复。

Method: RACL 将修复算子提升至分类器语义：候选在可负担修复下满足可行性且足够偏好时被接受，否则返回结构化拒绝信用及修复计划。

Result: 在DB1B衍生基准中，验证选优的RACL将假否决降至10/4039（FVR=0.0025），而最强修复搜索基线约为1064/4039，同时显式平衡FVR/EDR。

Conclusion: 修复优先否决视角严格泛化无修复语义，揭示终局否决的不可消除假否决缺口，区分二标签不可辨识性与决策规则可学习性，并给出可行性共享权重场景的容量与校准界。

Abstract: Hard constraints are usually treated as terminal vetoes: once a candidate violates a requirement, the learned rule rejects it and any repair is handled outside the decision semantics. This misses a common deployed regime in which the system already knows a finite menu of modifications, such as adding a ticket option, changing a configuration, or requesting an available service upgrade. Existing constraint-learning, soft-relaxation, and recourse methods address nearby problems, but they do not learn whether an option should be repaired before being vetoed. We introduce Repair-Augmented Constraint Learning (RACL), a contextual decision framework that lifts known repair operators into the classifier semantics. A candidate is accepted when an affordable repair makes it feasible and preferred enough; otherwise the system returns a structured rejection credit and, when applicable, a repair plan. This repair-before-veto view strictly generalizes no-repair HASSLE-style semantics, reveals an irreducible false-veto gap for terminal-veto rules, separates binary-label non-identifiability from decision-rule learnability, and gives capacity and calibration bounds for the observed-feasibility shared-weight setting. Across controlled and DB1B-derived benchmarks, RACL recovers the intended credit and repair structure. On the hardest raw-data-derived tier, validation-selected RACL reduces false vetoes to 10/4039 (FVR 0.0025), versus about 1064/4039 for the strongest repair-search black-box baseline, while making the FVR/EDR trade-off explicit.

</details>


### [273] [Forget Attention: Importance-Aware Attention Is All You Need](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02332)
*Soohyeong Shin,Yeongwook Yang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: SISA提出了一种新的混合机制，在注意力分数计算内部直接融合状态空间模型的重要性信号，无需递归状态或自定义内核，仅通过标准SDPA调用实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合架构（如Jamba、Hymba）将Transformer与SSM置于不同区块或头中，导致两者在注意力计算时互不干扰，无法实现真正的信息融合。

Method: 在softmax注意力分数中嵌入SSM导出的重要性项，并通过增广查询/键向量将完整操作转化为单次标准SDPA调用。

Result: 152M/5B规模下，LAMBADA-greedy达17.3%（优于Transformer的13.9%和Mamba-3的15.5%）；NIAH从第1K步起即达100%，检索收敛速度比Transformer快7倍；369M时Mamba-3在LAMBADA上领先，而SISA保持完美NIAH并兼容标准SDPA。

Conclusion: SISA定义了SSM-注意力混合的第三种设计轴——分数级融合，超越了块级和头级范式，实现了高效且兼容的混合建模。

Abstract: Combining attention's global retrieval with the sequential importance signal of state space models (SSMs) is the open challenge of hybrid language modeling. Transformers see everywhere but cannot prioritize; SSMs know what matters but cannot revisit. Existing hybrids -- Jamba (block level) and Hymba (head level) -- place the two in separate compartments, so neither informs the other during the attention computation itself. We propose SISA (SSM-Informed Softmax Attention), which adds an SSM-derived importance term directly inside the attention score and realizes the full operation as a single SDPA call on augmented query/key vectors -- no recurrent state, no custom kernel. At 152M / 5B tokens, SISA reaches LAMBADA-greedy 17.3% (vs. Transformer 13.9 and Mamba-3 15.5) and attains NIAH 100% from step 1K, 7x faster than Transformer's retrieval convergence; at 369M, Mamba-3 leads LAMBADA while SISA preserves perfect NIAH and stock-SDPA execution. SISA thus defines a third design axis for SSM-attention hybrids -- score-level fusion -- beyond the block-level and head-level paradigms that have dominated the field.

</details>


### [274] [MOC: Multi-Order Communication in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02359)
*Yao Guan,Lin Wang,Zhihu Lu,Ziyi Wang,Wenzhu Yan,Qiang Duan*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出多阶通信方案(MOC)，通过结构化多阶证据流和语义拓扑合并算法优化智能体间消息传递，在降低通信成本的同时提升多智能体系统任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统主要关注协调拓扑优化，忽视了消息传输与优化问题；当前直接拼接一阶邻居响应的通信方式导致证据感受野受限和关键信息在多跳路径中稀释。

Method: 设计多阶通信(MOC)方案，重构智能体间通信以捕获多跳依赖；形式化通信机制构建结构化多阶证据流，并设计语义拓扑合并算法在令牌约束下优化语义保真度。

Result: 在六个不同数据集和多种参数规模的LLM骨干网络上，MOC持续提升任务性能并降低通信成本。

Conclusion: MOC方案有效解决了多智能体系统中消息传递的效率与信息损失问题，为多跳依赖捕获和通信优化提供了新思路。

Abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Systems, most research focuses on optimizing coordination topology while largely underexploring the equally critical problem: how to transmit and optimize messages among agents effectively? Current communication schemes typically rely on the direct concatenation of first-order neighbor responses, which induces a restricted evidence receptive field and leads to the dilution of crucial insights over multi-hop paths. To address these limitations, we propose the Multi-Order Communication (MOC) scheme, which reconstructs the inter-agent communication to capture multi-hop dependencies and incorporates a structural message consolidation strategy to ensure efficiency. Specifically, we formalize the communication mechanism to construct a structured multi-order evidence stream, and subsequently design a Semantic-Topological Merging algorithm to optimize semantic fidelity within token constraints. Extensive experiments across six diverse datasets and LLM backbones of varying parameter scales demonstrate that MOC consistently improves task performance and reduces communication costs. The code is available at https://github.com/yao-guan/MOC.

</details>


### [275] [Revisiting Neural Processes via Fourier Transform and Volterra Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01172)
*Peiman Mohseni,Nick Duffield,Raymond K. W. Wong*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文通过Volterra展开理论表征连续平移等变算子，并提出集合傅里叶卷积（SFConvs）实现不规则采样点上的全局感受野和线性复杂度，进而设计两种条件神经过程模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有平移等变神经过程存在两个局限：非线性组件堆叠导致可解释性差，以及卷积方法依赖规则稠密网格或注意力方法带来平方复杂度。

Method: 利用Volterra展开将连续平移等变算子分解为高阶卷积和，并用一阶卷积高效近似；提出集合傅里叶卷积（SFConvs）在频域参数化，直接处理不规则采样点，实现全局感受野和线性复杂度。基于此构建SFConvCNP（堆叠非线性SFConv块）和SFVConvCNP（集成Volterra公式）。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，所提方法在性能上优于现有最先进基线。

Conclusion: 本文的理论分析和提出的SFConvs有效解决了现有方法的可解释性和计算效率问题，为不规则采样数据建模提供了高效且透明的方案。

Abstract: Modeling unknown latent functions from finite, irregularly sampled measurements is a recurring challenge across science and engineering. Neural processes (NPs), a family of probabilistic functional models, are promising solutions -- especially when endowed with domain-specific symmetries like translation equivariance, which improve sample efficiency and generalization. Yet existing translation-equivariant NPs face two limitations: (i) they stack generic components with non-linearities, obscuring the induced function class and limiting interpretability; and (ii) convolutional designs rely on kernels with local receptive fields and require dense uniform input grids, while attention-based methods avoid these issues but scale quadratically with the number of observations. We address both with two contributions. First, using the Volterra expansion, we characterize continuous translation-equivariant operators as sums of higher-order convolutions, yielding analytical transparency while admitting efficient approximation by first-order convolutions. Second, we introduce set Fourier convolutions (SFConvs), a frequency-domain parameterization that operates directly on irregularly sampled points, achieves approximately global receptive fields, and scales linearly in the number of observations. Building on these ideas, we propose two conditional NPs (CNPs): SFConvCNPs, which stack SFConv blocks with non-linearities, and SFVConvCNPs, which integrate the Volterra formulation. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate our methods' efficacy against state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [276] [Temporal Motif Signatures for Temporal Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01176)
*Dylan Sandfelder,Mihai Cucuringu,Xiaowen Dong*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种紧凑的13维局部模体特征映射，能显著提升多种时间图神经网络的性能，其设计基于对真实与合成时间数据集中模体活动三个稳定轴（二元近因/互惠性、星型多样性、三元流）的实证分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间交互流中的短视模体模式（重复、互惠、星型多样性、三元流）包含预测结构，但传统时间图神经网络（TGNN）未能有效利用这些特征，导致预测性能受限。

Method: 通过实证分析识别出模体活动的三个尺度稳定轴，设计泄漏安全的13维局部模体特征映射h(u,v,t)，可线性嵌入任意静态或时间编码器，无需改变架构。

Result: 在TGB链路属性预测（五个基线）、比特币Alpha/OTC和MOOC边分类、以及合成时间生成器的图级分类任务中，该特征映射一致提升性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的模体特征映射是一种简单有效的增强方法，能广泛提升异构时间图任务的预测能力，且具有理论支持（时间WL分析）。

Abstract: Real temporal interaction streams carry predictive structure in short-horizon motif patterns -- repetition, reciprocity, star diversity, triadic flow -- that vanilla temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) often fail to expose to their edge scorers. We show this concretely on MOOC interaction prediction, where a small four-feature family of past-window star counts already delivers most of the lift over a strong static GNN. Across a wide set of real and synthetic temporal datasets we find that motif activity organizes consistently along three scale-stable axes (dyadic recency/reciprocity, star diversity, triadic flow), and we use this empirical structure to design a compact 13-coordinate, leakage-safe, candidate-local motif feature map h(u, v, t) that linearly embeds into any static or temporal encoder without architectural changes. A temporal Weisfeiler-Leman (WL) analysis places the augmentation relative to the first level of an anchored temporal-WL hierarchy and exhibits a candidate-anchored pair on which motif features distinguish. We demonstrate empirically that the same augmentation consistently lifts performance across heterogeneous tasks: TGB link-property prediction across all five baselines, edge classification on Bitcoin Alpha/OTC and MOOC, and graph-level classification of synthetic temporal generators.

</details>


### [277] [A Mathematical Conflict Framework for Contextual Data Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02381)
*Hakan Emre Kartal*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出了一个基于广义算子的数学冲突框架，将冲突表示为局部、有向且上下文敏感的量，并整合加权、尺度行为和输出映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常将冲突视为优化过程中的隐式副作用，缺乏显式的数学表示；该框架旨在将冲突作为独立、基于算子、组件级的数学对象来处理。

Method: 构建了一个通用抽象算子结构，显式表示原始数据与上下文数据间的结构差异，不依赖特定学习算法或优化方法。

Result: 该框架可适应不同类别的问题，将冲突视为局部、有向且上下文敏感的独立量。

Conclusion: 提出的算子框架为冲突提供了统一的形式化表达，使其从隐式副作用转变为显式的数学组件，具有广泛的适用性。

Abstract: In this study, a generalized operator-based mathematical conflict framework is presented to explicitly represent structural discrepancies between raw data and contextual data. The proposed structure treats conflict as a local, directional, and context-sensitive quantity, integrating components such as weighting, scale behavior, and output mapping under a unified abstract operator. Without being reduced to a specific learning algorithm or optimization method, the framework is defined as a general structure adaptable to different classes of problems. While existing approaches typically treat conflict merely as an implicit side effect embedded within the optimization process, the proposed framework considers conflict as an independent, operator-based, and component-level mathematical object.

</details>


### [278] [Riemannian Optimization for Hadamard Products of Low-Rank Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01216)
*Pratik Jawanpuria,Ankish Chandresh,Bamdev Mishra*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于黎曼流形的低秩矩阵Hadamard积学习方法，通过设计块对角黎曼度量实现尺度不变性，并开发了线性复杂度的梯度下降算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低秩矩阵的Hadamard积在参数效率建模中受限于行/列缩放对称性，现有方法难以有效处理这种几何结构。

Method: 将Hadamard积学习问题建模为黎曼商流形上的优化，提出由Frobenius内积回拉导出的块对角黎曼度量，并设计使用自适应Gauss-Newton步长的黎曼梯度下降算法，每次迭代计算复杂度与观测条目数线性相关。

Result: 在合成与真实数据上的实验验证了所提黎曼方法相较于基准方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过黎曼几何框架有效解决了低秩Hadamard积学习中的尺度对称性问题，算法兼具理论保障与计算效率。

Abstract: The elementwise Hadamard product of two low-rank matrices provides a parameter-efficient model for data with multiplicative structure, but its modeling is challenging due to the presence of additional symmetries under coupled row/column scalings between the two factors. In order to leverage the geometry of the space, we formulate the learning of such matrices as optimization on a Riemannian quotient manifold. We propose a novel block-diagonal Riemannian metric derived from the pullback of the Frobenius inner product. The metric is shown to be invariant under the full symmetry group. We develop a Riemannian gradient descent algorithm that uses a tuning-free Gauss--Newton step size and scales linearly in the number of observed entries per iteration. Experiments on real and synthetic datasets illustrate the efficacy of our proposed Riemannian approach.

</details>


### [279] [Hybrid Imbalanced Regression Through Unified Data-Level and Algorithm-Level Balancing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01221)
*Shermin Shahbazi,Hossein Mohammadi,Mohsen Afsharchi*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种统一混合框架，集成数据级和算法级平衡策略，用于解决不平衡回归问题，并通过条件变分自编码器、聚类过采样、密度加权损失和注意力融合等五阶段流程提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不平衡回归方法在数据级易引入噪声和过拟合，算法级难以处理复杂目标分布，需一种通用且鲁棒的混合方案。

Method: 五阶段框架：自适应分箱划分目标空间、条件变分自编码器学习目标条件表示、多阶段数据平衡（特征聚类和少数类过采样）、潜密度加权损失强调稀有样本、注意力门控融合进行最终回归。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上显著优于独立回归器和现有不平衡回归方法，一致提升预测性能。

Conclusion: 该混合框架有效结合两类平衡策略，为不平衡回归提供了一种高性能且与回归器无关的解决方案。

Abstract: Imbalanced learning is a critical challenge in machine learning, where underrepresented target values can bias models and degrade prediction performance on rare but important cases. Although extensively studied in classification, imbalanced regression remains relatively underexplored. Existing methods mainly focus on either data-level balancing, which may introduce noise and overfitting, or algorithm-level balancing, which often struggles with highly complex target distributions. To address these limitations, we propose a unified hybrid framework that integrates both data- and algorithm-level balancing strategies into a regressor-agnostic pipeline. The proposed framework consists of five stages: (1) adaptive bin partitioning to dynamically segment the target space based on local linear coherence; (2) target-conditioned representation learning using a Conditional Variational Autoencoder; (3) multistage data-level balancing through feature-space clustering and oversampling of minority clusters; (4) algorithm-level balancing using a novel Latent-Density Weighted Loss (LDWL) to emphasize rare samples in latent and target spaces; and (5) attention-based gated fusion for final regression. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves predictive performance compared to standalone regressors and existing imbalanced regression approaches.

</details>


### [280] [Beyond Sinusoids: A Morlet Wavelet Framework for Transformer Positional Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01258)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出Morlet小波位置编码(MoPE)，通过学习频率和局部带宽统一了正弦PE和RoPE，并在字符级语言建模中取得改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准位置编码（正弦PE、RoPE）将每个位置视为同等局部，仅编码位置信息却无法控制位置影响范围，缺乏局部性带宽学习能力。

Method: 将Morlet小波作为位置编码基函数，每个嵌入维度独立学习频率和局部带宽参数；通过相位恢复RoPE旋转角，幅度引入高斯局部性核；结合能量门控注意力机制。

Result: 在TinyShakespeare上，MoPE+能量门控注意力相比标准注意力提升0.119，且128个频率-带宽对均收敛至小波容许边界。

Conclusion: MoPE统一了正弦PE和RoPE的理论框架，其学习的局部性参数揭示了字符级语言信号的固有特性，值得进一步研究。

Abstract: Standard positional encodings for transformers - sinusoidal and rotary (RoPE) - treat every position as equally local: they encode where a token is, but not how far its positional influence should extend. We propose that the Morlet wavelet, which simultaneously minimises uncertainty in position and frequency, is the natural basis for positional encoding, and introduce Morlet Positional Encoding (MoPE): each embedding dimension learns its own frequency and locality bandwidth from data. The main theoretical result is a unification: sinusoidal PE and the RoPE correlation kernel both emerge as limiting cases of MoPE when locality is switched off (sigma_i -> infinity). The phase of MoPE recovers the RoPE rotation angle exactly; the amplitude adds a learned Gaussian locality kernel that standard encodings lack. Empirically, MoPE combined with Energy-Gated Attention achieves +0.119 improvement over standard attention on TinyShakespeare, outperforming either component alone. Analysis of the learned parameters reveals that all 128 frequency-bandwidth pairs converge to the wavelet admissibility boundary - an empirical observation consistent with a companion result on energy gating, suggesting a reproducible property of character-level language signals that warrants further investigation.

</details>


### [281] [RASER: Recoverability-Aware Selective Escalation Router for Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02488)
*Yuyang Li,Zihe Yan,Tobias Käfer*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: RASER提出了基于一次性RAG的轻量级路由方法，在保持F1竞争力的同时显著降低令牌成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳问答系统常对每个问题使用昂贵的检索，但许多问题可通过一次性RAG正确回答，避免不必要的额外检索以节省预算。

Method: RASER利用一次性RAG和六个特征构建廉价路由，RASER-2决定停止或升级至PRUNE，RASER-3进一步增加成本-准确率权衡选择，无需额外LLM调用。

Result: 在六个LLM和三个基准测试中，RASER在F1指标上与SOTA基线相当，但仅消耗始终PRUNE方法41-49%的令牌，且低于迭代和分解检索基线。

Conclusion: RASER实现了高效多跳问答，在不牺牲准确率的前提下大幅降低检索成本。

Abstract: Multi-hop question-answering systems often use expensive retrieval on every question. They may decompose the question, run several retrieval rounds, or search through bridge entities before answering. All of these strategies rely on repeated LLM calls to rewrite or decompose the question, which increases extra token cost, and it is not fitting when the LLM budget is tight. However, our analysis shows that lots of multi-hop questions are already answered correctly by a single one-shot RAG, so running an extra retrieval on every question wastes the budget. We introduce RASER (Recoverability-Aware Selective Escalation Router), a family of cheap routers built on one-shot RAG and six features from it. RASER-2 decides whether to stop or escalate to the extra-retrieval action PRUNE. RASER-3 chooses among one-shot RAG, PRUNE, and iterative retrieval IRCoT, using the same features but adding an explicit cost-accuracy trade-off. Neither router makes an extra LLM call to decide. Across six LLMs and three multi-hop QA benchmarks, both routers stay competitive with the other state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines in F1 while spending only 41-49% of always-prune's tokens and also less than the iterative and decomposition retrieval baselines.

</details>


### [282] [What Makes a Strong Model? A Unified Spectral Analysis of Knowledge Transfer over High-dimensional Linear Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01292)
*Wendao Wu,Fangqing Zhang,Haihan Zhang,Cong Fang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文通过谱分析统一解释了知识蒸馏与弱到强泛化中知识迁移的效率机制，揭示了谱地平线扩展与谱去噪两种核心原理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识迁移研究缺乏统一理论框架，无法解释知识蒸馏与弱到强泛化等不同范式下的共同机理。

Method: 对高维线性回归中SGD动力学进行统一谱分析，从隐式正则化与异质谱学习速度角度建模知识迁移效率。

Result: 发现知识蒸馏通过谱地平线扩展捕获统计不可及的高频信号，弱到强泛化通过谱去噪过滤优化噪声。

Conclusion: 知识迁移效率由隐式正则化与谱异质学习速度的相互作用决定，为不同迁移范式提供了统一理论解释。

Abstract: Teacher-Student Knowledge Transfer (KT) is ubiquitous in modern machine learning, ranging from classical model compression via Knowledge Distillation (KD) to the emergent phenomenon of Weak-to-Strong (W2S) generalization. While existing studies offer isolated insights, a unified theoretical framework explaining the efficacy of KT across these disparate regimes remains lacking. In this work, we establish a unified spectral analysis of SGD dynamics in high-dimensional linear regression, elucidating the efficiency of KT across seemingly disparate regimes. We characterize KT efficiency through two distinct mechanisms: \emph{Spectral Horizon Expansion} in KD, which enables the capture of statistically inaccessible high-frequency signals, and \emph{Spectral Denoising} in W2S, where the student acts as a filter for optimization noise. Our framework unifies these phenomena, revealing that the efficacy of transfer is governed by the interplay between implicit regularization and heterogeneous spectral learning speeds over the spectrum.

</details>


### [283] [Structure and Scale in Simplicial Sequence Modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01302)
*Matthew Farrugia-Roberts*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该研究提出深度学习的两种现象（行为缩放定律与涌现机制）可能存在关联，并在小规模Transformer上通过隐藏马尔可夫模型任务验证了性能缩放与表征结构之间的相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连接可预测的性能提升（行为缩放定律）与内部计算结构的有序变化（涌现机制）这两大经验现象，揭示其内在因果联系。

Method: 训练预测隐藏马尔可夫模型输出的少量Transformer，利用残差激活在概率单纯形上线性编码隐状态信念分布的特性，分析性能缩放模式与表征结构变化的相关性。

Result: 发现性能缩放模式与表征结构（信念分布编码）之间存在明显相关性，为行为与内部结构的关联提供了初步证据。

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Modern large-scale deep learning exhibits two striking empirical phenomena: behavioural scaling laws (predictable performance gains with increasing scale) and emergent mechanisms (structured internal representations and circuits in deep neural networks). We hypothesise that these two phenomena are connected: that predictable changes in behaviour are the result of predictable changes in internal computational structure. In this paper, we report preliminary evidence of such a connection. We find a correlation between scaling patterns in performance and representations in small transformers trained to predict the outputs of a hidden Markov model, for which residual activations are known to linearly encode a belief distribution over latent states in a probability simplex.

</details>


### [284] [ClinEnv: An Interactive Multi-Stage Long Horizon EHR Environment for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02568)
*Yuxing Lu,Yushuhong Lin,Wenqi Shi,J. Ben Tamo,Xukai Zhao,Jinzhuo Wang,May Dongmei Wang*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出ClinEnv交互式基准，通过纵向住院模拟评估LLM的临床决策能力，发现最强模型决策F1仅0.31，信息获取与决策质量严重脱节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有静态基准和交互式医学基准无法同时评估LLM在真实住院场景中处理异构信息、执行序贯不可逆决策的能力。

Method: 构建纵向住院模拟范式，将每个病例自动转为有序决策阶段，模型需主动查询四个专业代理后做出用药、手术、诊断承诺，并通过本体匹配和过程质量双维度评分。

Result: 七个模型中最佳决策F1仅0.31，管理决策F1(0.17)远低于出院诊断F1(0.51)，后期阶段存在冗余查询，信息获取差距在仅评估结果的基准中不可见。

Conclusion: ClinEnv揭示了LLM临床决策中知-行分离的关键缺陷，使信息获取质量成为可量化的独立评估维度。

Abstract: Clinical practice is not the selection of an answer from enumerated options: a physician gathers heterogeneous information incrementally and commits to sequential, irreversible decisions under uncertainty. Static benchmarks cannot probe and existing interactive medical benchmarks each compromise on at least one of them. We present ClinEnv, an interactive benchmark that evaluates LLMs as attending physicians over real inpatient admissions under a paradigm we term Longitudinal Inpatient Simulation. Each case is automatically constructed into an ordered sequence of decision stages; at every stage the model must actively query four specialized agents before committing to medications, procedures, and diagnoses. ClinEnv scores both what the model decides, through deterministic ontology-grounded matching, and how it gathers information. Across seven models, the strongest reaches only 0.31 decision F1, and outcome quality is sharply decoupled from process quality. Difficulty concentrates in management decisions and later stages, where models recover discharge diagnoses far more reliably than management actions (0.51 vs. 0.17 F1) and continue to issue redundant queries as cases progress. ClinEnv makes this information-acquisition gap, invisible to outcome-only evaluation, directly measurable.

</details>


### [285] [FAiT: Frequency-Aware Inverted Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01306)
*Peng He,Yao Liu,Yanglei Gan,Run Lin,Yuxiang Cai,Qiao Liu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出FAiT，通过可学习的高通分支和动态时频调制，解决Transformer在多变量时间序列预测中的频谱偏差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer的自注意力机制充当低通滤波器，平滑高频信号；现有频域方法使用固定谱基和序列级均匀调制，忽略了真实序列的时变频谱特性。

Method: 使用反向注意力矩阵构建可学习的高通分支，恢复衰减的瞬态信号；引入动态时频调制，通过实例条件权重自适应校准频谱子带能量。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，FAiT一致优于最先进的Transformer和频域增强基线，同时保持计算效率。

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: While Transformer-based architectures have established themselves as a dominant paradigm in Multivariate Time Series Forecasting (MTSF), their core self-attention mechanism inherently functions as a low-pass filter, systematically smoothing out high-frequency signals vital for sharp local changes. Recent advancements have increasingly incorporated frequency-domain operations to address this bias, however, most existing designs rely on fixed spectral bases and apply sequence-wise (uniform) modulation, implicitly assuming a time-invariant frequency response. This overlooks a key property of real-world series that their spectral characteristics often evolve over time, making uniform modulation insufficient for capturing fine-grained temporal dynamics. To tackle these limitations, we propose FAiT, a Frequency-Aware inverted Transformer. Specifically, FAiT rectifies the spectral bias internally through Inverted Attention, which interprets the attention map as a learnable low-pass operator and constructs a dedicated complementary high-pass branch by inverting the attention matrix to recover attenuated transient signals. Furthermore, FAiT introduces Dynamic Temporal-Frequency Modulation (DTFM), which synthesizes instance-conditioned weights to adaptively re-calibrate the energy of spectral sub-bands, enabling fine-grained control over evolving multi-scale patterns. Extensive experiments on widely used benchmarks demonstrate that FAiT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art Transformer-based and frequency-enhanced baselines, while maintaining computational efficiency.

</details>


### [286] [Sample Complexity and Decision-Theoretic Guarantees for Bayesian Model Averaging over Decision Trees with Catalan-Exponential Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01340)
*Livija Jakaite,Vitaly Schetinin*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文针对贝叶斯模型平均（BMA）权重在决策树中何时蕴含足够认知信息以支持对其分布的承诺性利用问题，给出了闭合形式的答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确定BMA权重在决策树中是否提供足够证据，以理性地承诺利用平均分布，避免过早或过度承诺导致的决策风险。

Method: 针对具有Dirichlet-多项式叶模型和Catalan-指数树规模先验的贝叶斯决策树（BDT），建立了理性承诺阈值的完整非渐进理论。

Result: 给出了闭合形式的理性承诺阈值，为BMA权重的认知充分性提供了精确判定标准。

Conclusion: 该理论为在有限样本下何时依赖BMA分布进行决策提供了严格指导，填补了非渐进情境下承诺性利用的理性依据空白。

Abstract: We ask: when do Bayesian model averaging (BMA) weights over decision trees carry sufficient epistemic information to justify committed exploitation of the averaging distribution? We answer this question in closed form for Bayesian decision trees (BDTs) with Dirichlet-Multinomial leaf models and a Catalan-exponential tree-size prior (Schetinin&Jakaite, 2025), establishing a complete non-asymptotic theory of rational commitment thresholds.

</details>


### [287] [From Performance to Viability: A Bootstrap Framework for Latent-Space Representation Learning in Adaptive Biological Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01374)
*Jacques Raynal,Pierre Slangen,Elsa Raynal,Jacques Margerit*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出一种自举框架，通过五个分析层级从观测性能逐步学习自适应生物系统的潜在空间表示，以超越性能驱动的解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应系统中相似性能可能源于不同组织方式，且静态性能无法反映纵向动态轨迹，现有方法缺乏在无完整机制模型前提下从数据中生成更丰富表示的途径。

Method: 围绕五个层级（可观性能、动态组织、潜在组织、纵向生存力、内部预测近似）构建自举框架，通过逐层引入新分析层级应对前一层级解释不足的问题，并用步态遮挡研究序列作为方法论案例验证。

Result: 形式化了从性能分析到潜在组织、从静态潜在组织到纵向生存力、从观测生存力到内部预测近似的逻辑递进过程，展示了表示层级随观测不足而自动提升的能力。

Conclusion: 该框架并非新算法或数据集，而是一种方法论，为自适应生物数据中从观测局限性到更信息丰富表示的涌现提供了系统化路径。

Abstract: Observable performance is commonly used to characterize biological systems. In adaptive systems, however, similar performances may arise from distinct organizations, and configurations that appear comparable at a given time may follow different longitudinal trajectories. This limitation motivates a methodological framework for moving beyond performance-based interpretation without assuming a complete mechanistic model in advance. This article proposes a bootstrap framework for latent-space representation learning in adaptive biological systems. Here, bootstrap is used in a methodological and epistemological sense: new analytical levels are introduced when the preceding representation becomes insufficient to account for observed adaptive dynamics. The framework is organized around five levels: observable performance, dynamic organization, latent organization, longitudinal viability, and internal predictive approximation. The framework is illustrated by three previously reported gait--occlusion studies, used here only as a methodological case sequence and not as new experimental evidence. The article formalizes how performance analysis led to latent organization, how static latent organization led to longitudinal viability, and how observed viability led to internal predictive approximation. The contribution is not a new learning algorithm, clinical protocol, or dataset, but a bootstrap framework for latent-space representation learning describing how increasingly informative representations can emerge from observational insufficiencies in adaptive biological data.

</details>


### [288] [Turning Back Without Forgetting: Selective Backward Refinement for Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01379)
*Anushka Tiwari,Kaiyi Ji*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出SABER框架，通过选择性后向优化实现提示参数高效持续学习中的正向后向知识迁移，无需重放数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示式持续学习方法虽能缓解灾难性遗忘，但任务特定提示的孤立性阻碍了后向知识迁移，即后续任务无法改进先前任务。

Method: SABER利用双重互补准则（基于提示梯度几何和损失分布相似性）判断何时进行后向优化，并通过限制参数更新至非干扰方向确保安全迁移。

Result: 在T5-Large、LLaMA、Qwen等多种预训练骨干网络上的持续学习基准测试中，SABER持续实现正向后向迁移并保持强平均性能。

Conclusion: SABER有效解决了提示式持续学习中的后向迁移缺失问题，在无重放下实现了可控且有益的知识回溯。代码已开源。

Abstract: While prompt-based parameter-efficient continual learning mitigates catastrophic forgetting by isolating task-specific prompts, this isolation also limits later tasks from improving earlier ones, leaving backward knowledge transfer underexplored. We address this limitation by proposing Selective bAckward refinement for positive Backward knowledge transfER (SABER), a replay-free framework that enables controlled backward transfer in prompt-based continual learning. SABER determines when backward refinement is beneficial using complementary task-correlation criteria based on prompt-gradient geometry and loss-distribution similarity, and how to perform refinement safely by restricting updates to non-interfering directions in the prompt parameter space. Extensive experiments across multiple continual learning benchmarks and diverse pretrained backbones, including T5-Large, LLaMA, and Qwen, demonstrate that SABER consistently achieves positive backward transfer while maintaining strong overall average performance. Code is available at https://github.com/OptMN-Lab/SABER-ICML-2026/.

</details>


### [289] [Leaf Spectral Reflectance Prediction Using Multi-Head Attention Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01432)
*Parastoo Farajpoor,Alireza Pourreza,Mohammadreza Narimani,Ashraf El-Kereamy,Matthew W. Fidelibus*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一个多头注意力神经网络模型，利用葡萄特定数据集基于16种叶片性状预测光谱反射率，平均R²为0.84，NRMSE为1.52%，在近红外和短波红外区域优于PROSPECT-PRO模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有辐射传输模型（如PROSPECT-PRO）基于通用性状-反射率关系，无法完全捕捉特定作物（如葡萄）的光谱行为，需开发物种特异性模型以提高预测精度。

Method: 使用多头注意力神经网络，以16种叶片性状为输入，在包含多个品种、生长阶段和年份的葡萄数据集上训练，并进行分层5折交叉验证评估。

Result: 模型平均R²为0.84，NRMSE为1.52%，在近红外和短波红外区域MAE低于PROSPECT-PRO，表现出高精度和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 物种特异性建模方法结合数据驱动架构能显著提升光谱预测性能，为叶片反射率生成和葡萄园遥感监测提供稳健框架。

Abstract: Accurate modeling of leaf spectral reflectance from physiological and biochemical traits is essential for advancing remote sensing applications in plant science and precision agriculture.
